walking_tolerance: short bursts with frequent breaks — traveling with a 6-year-old

days.design_note: Everything today sits within Old Town, a short walk from the hotel — deliberately chosen to minimize backtracking per the accommodation constraint. Castle first while queues are shorter, a relaxed walk down the Royal Mile, and Camera Obscura in the afternoon as a lighter, interactive stop that works well for a 6-year-old.

stops.name: Royal Mile
notes: Casual walk-through, street performers and shops.

stops.name: Camera Obscura & World of Illusions
notes: Interactive and family-friendly — good fit for a 6-year-old's attention span.

meal_options.note: Many casual family-friendly cafes along the Royal Mile — a candidate, not a fixed booking.

days.design_note: A lighter day built around Arthur's Seat and the National Museum of Scotland. The summit ascent is skipped in favor of the shorter Dunsapie Loch viewpoint path, given the family's stamina constraint, and the museum's free, unhurried, indoor format works as a natural afternoon wind-down — and a rain backup, per the soft weather constraint.

stops.name: Arthur's Seat (Dunsapie Loch viewpoint path)
notes: Shortened viewpoint path from Dunsapie Loch, not the full summit ascent — the summit path has loose gravel and no barriers, not recommended for young children.

stops.name: National Museum of Scotland
notes: Free entry. Closes 17:00 — comfortably ahead of our 14:30 departure, no last-admission constraint applies.

meal_options.note: Casual lunch near Holyrood Park before heading to the museum.

days.design_note: A short, low-key morning at the Royal Botanic Garden before collecting luggage and heading to Waverley for the 16:00 train — deliberately unscheduled after 11:30 to leave slack for a delay or a tired child, rather than planning right up to departure.

stops.name: Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh
notes: Free entry to the outdoor gardens; no last-admission restriction. Timed to leave a comfortable margin before the 16:00 departure, including a stop at the hotel to collect luggage.

meal_options.note: Relaxed cafe options for a final lunch before departure.

constraints.description: Traveling with a 6-year-old — avoid full-day hikes and long unbroken queues
Hotel confirmed in Old Town — minimize daily backtracking to it
Prefer indoor backup options in case of rain

assumptions.description: Assumed the mid-range budget applies to attraction tickets, not accommodation
assumptions.reason: Traveler confirmed the hotel is already booked but didn't specify a separate ticket budget
